claims.text: Post-process laser remelting will improve the dimensional precision of LPBF-fabricated HEA components relative to as-printed components.
Post-process laser remelting will improve the mechanical integrity of LPBF-fabricated HEA components relative to as-printed components.
Post-process laser remelting will reduce fabrication-induced defects in LPBF-fabricated HEA components.
Laser remelting locally re-melts the surface and near-surface regions.
Local remelting allows pores and related defects to heal or close.
Laser remelting smooths the component surface.
Rapid solidification following laser remelting refines the microstructure.
Laser remelting produces more homogeneous grain boundaries.
The combined effects of defect healing, surface smoothing, and microstructural refinement enhance mechanical integrity and dimensional precision.
Laser-remelted samples will have lower surface roughness than as-printed samples.
Laser-remelted samples will have a lower porosity volume fraction than as-printed samples.
Laser-remelted samples will have higher yield strength than as-printed samples.
Laser-remelted samples will have higher ductility than as-printed samples.
Laser-remelted samples will have dimensional tolerances closer to the design specifications than as-printed samples.
The hypothesized benefits require remelting parameters that avoid excessive evaporation, oxidation, keyholing, and cracking.
The intervention may not benefit HEAs containing highly volatile constituents or alloys prone to hot cracking during rapid remelting.
The magnitude of dimensional and mechanical improvement depends on HEA composition and laser-remelting parameters.

contradictions.description: The hypothesis predicts improvement in dimensional precision, mechanical integrity, and defect reduction, but the falsification rule requires improvement in only two of four metric categories. The hypothesis could therefore avoid falsification even if a central predicted category, such as dimensional accuracy or mechanical strength, does not improve.
